responsibility: Implements arithmetic-statement lowering and arithmetic-exception plumbing for the COBOL front end. It prepares ON SIZE ERROR and compute-error labels, packages arithmetic operands and rounding metadata, selects the appropriate libgcobol runtime entry points for ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY/DIVIDE variants and formats, and emits the surrounding GENERIC needed to move results, handle remainders, and branch according to COBOL arithmetic error semantics.
same_name_distinction: Contains the arithmetic-lowering implementation itself, wiring ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY/DIVIDE forms to libgcobol helpers and emitted error-handling control flow. In contrast, genmath.h only exposes the small label-setup helpers used by that machinery.
